_fictional: SIMULATED / FICTIONAL. The deficiencies of the invented customer S3 (s3-def) for the CES simulator (synthetic-customer PLAN.md section 2.1b). No real organisation is described.
about: One row per deficiency S3 carries by design: PLAN section 2.1b's six rows (plan_ref '2.1b'), split where a row names two objects, plus the deficiencies the W6 brief adds (plan_ref 'W6 brief'). For each: the controls, what is wrong and where it is seeded, who fixes it, the E6 / E6X / E7A path, the predicted EO status at E7 (after E6X) and E7B (after E7A), and the GAPS.md row a run is expected to show. A later harness check can assert every row's gaps_row against out/GAPS-s3-def.json (PLAN section 1 S3 extra threshold: every section 2.1b deficiency appears in GAPS.md). gaps.mjs does not emit source 'deficiency' rows yet (its note: 'S3 deficiency rows (PLAN section 2.1b) are added in W6'); until it does, gaps_also lists the rows today's sources already produce. Statuses are predictions until the first run (no end-to-end run in W6). Optional fields read by gaps.mjs (W6 follow-up, run 63): match = case-insensitive substrings looked for in the finding (SSP assessmentFinding) and the text of a GAPS row on one of the deficiency's controls; stamper_entries = the Stamper registry entries that are this deficiency's fix (a SAT state record of one of them counts as the fixer acting).
gaps_row_columns: module | control | item | what the assessor needs (needs) | what we have (have) | owner | source (GAPS.md column order, PLAN section 4); the id is derived from content by gaps.mjs and is not predicted here

fixers.Stamper: fixed at E6 by a Stamper SET-path entry; not re-injected
fixers.AdminOps: re-injected at E6X where PLAN section 2.1b says so, then remediated by the named AdminOps op at E7A
fixers.AdminOps (held): PLAN section 2.1b assigns an AdminOps op, but the op cannot be bound on today's harness (no registry-record key for its parameter); the deficiency stays and the op is an open item
fixers.organisation: no CES module can fix it (people, process or records); stays a finding for the customer
fixers.finding-only: PLAN section 2.1b leaves it untouched on purpose (detection proof): it stays and EO must report it (POA&M item expected)
